notes: The PDF pages are low-resolution images; many element-to-step assignments are best guesses (which red slope/bracket sits in each step).
Step 4 shows a red slope under the black bracket although only the bracket is in the callout; I assumed 303921 goes on first.
Step 7's red U-shaped piece is assumed to be the red hinge clip brick 393721; the second pyramid slope 4195004 is placed in the nose sub-assembly (page 15).

To match the parts-page counts, pieces whose position is not clearly readable are placed approximately: the 4 extra 379421 plates act as mounts for the 2 flames (6056842) and 2 tan flame-hair pieces (4261397); extra 4282742 (x2), 6001806, 6043656, 4524644, 302221 and 4539097 are attached at plausible head/nose positions.
Flame and flame-hair elements are joined to their 379421 mount plates with null ports (push-on), because their exact connection geometry is not readable and a pin-to-stud pairing is not valid.
The red claw plate 4524644 (b22, b38) is joined with a null port on its side; its 'top' port is a stud and cannot pair with a stud, and the clip geometry is not legible.
Several joins to the head base plate and brackets use null ports because the catalogue entries have a single stud port; they are separate studs in reality.

Page 18 repeats a short list (2x 4534648, 303921, 4220515, 4211375, 2x 4282742, 1x 6001806); I treated these as the same pieces already counted, but the totals (4x 4282742, 2x 6001806) are honoured by adding extras.
Jaw copies attach to head base, front bracket and side bracket respectively (approximate).
Feet are joined to the two ball-socket ends of 6043656 via the grey ball-end pin; arms clip onto the black finger plates.
